description: Encounter system. Each dungeon has a base difficulty and a set of encounters that scale with the player's difficulty slider. The slider adjusts monster stats on top of the base difficulty.

difficulty_slider.effect: All monster primary stats are multiplied by: 1 + (slider - 1) × 0.25. Loot quality and XP/gold rewards also scale.

encounter_count_formula.description: Number of encounters before boss = base_encounters + floor(slider / 3)

encounter_generation_rules.description: When the player enters a dungeon, encounters are generated from the dungeon's enemy pool. Each encounter picks enemies based on the wave template.

elite_monsters.description: Elites are regular monsters with boosted stats, a prefix, and one bonus ability.

rest_points.description: After certain encounters, the party gets a rest point where they recover a portion of HP/MP.
